verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SPLASHDOWN! ... at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT) ... Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego'; R2: 'Landing date April 11, 2026, 00:07:27 UTC (April 10, 5:07:27 p.m. PDT) ... Pacific Ocean southwest of San Diego'
verifications.reasoning: Exact date, time, location, and ocean match directly across multiple sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission had a four-person crew.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen'; R2: 'Crew size 4 Members Reid Wiseman Victor Glover Christina Koch Jeremy Hansen'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state four-person crew with matching names.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission crew completed a 10-day trip around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'carrying NASA astronauts ... on an approximate 10-day mission around the Moon'; R2: 'approximately ten-day trip'; R3: '10-day journey to fly around the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe it as a 10-day (approximate) lunar flyby mission.

verifications.claim: The Orion capsule was recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Orion spacecraft is secured in the well deck of USS John P. Murtha'; R2: 'Recovered by USS John P. Murtha'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements confirm recovery by the named ship.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission crew members were Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and ... Jeremy Hansen'; R2: 'Members Reid Wiseman Victor Glover Christina Koch Jeremy Hansen'
verifications.reasoning: Exact crew names listed in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis 2 mission crew returned in good health.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'safely aboard ... post-mission medical evaluations'; R3: 'all feeling fine ... in good health and spirits'; R4: 'hale and hearty'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm crew safe, healthy, and in good spirits post-recovery.

verifications.claim: Artemis 2 was the first crewed mission to return from the vicinity of the Moon in over 53 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'; R3: 'first humans ... since the Apollo 17 mission of December 1972'
verifications.reasoning: Apollo 17 (1972) to 2026 is over 53 years; explicitly first crewed lunar return.

verifications.claim: The capsule survived a 5,000-degree Fahrenheit re-entry before splashing down in the Pacific.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R7: 'temperatures of up to 5,000 degrees Fahrenheit'; R6: 'Temperatures can be up to 5,000 degrees'; R1: successful re-entry and Pacific splashdown
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm ~5,000°F re-entry temperatures and successful Pacific splashdown.
